environment.description: Jenkins CI runner (v2.401.1) on Ubuntu 22.04 with pipeline plugin loaded. The SCRIPT_REGISTRY_URL points to an internal HTTP endpoint (http://build-scripts.internal:8080) with no TLS. DNS resolution is handled by the cluster's CoreDNS without DNSSEC. The pipeline executor runs as the jenkins user with network access to arbitrary internal hosts. No content security policy or script pinning is enforced at the infrastructure level.

config.network: Flat internal network, HTTP registry endpoint, no mTLS
config.integrity_enforcement: none - relies solely on application-level check which can be bypassed via null manifest
